recognize_zh: 中央一群細胞呈圓形核、染色質呈粗顆粒狀，周圍有一圈深藍色、無顆粒的細胞質（basophilic cytoplasm），旁邊還有核深染縮小的晚期幼紅血球，符合嗜鹼性幼紅血球（basophilic normoblasts）。
features: Cluster of medium-sized cells with round central nuclei and high N:C ratio
Chromatin coarsely granular with a checkerboard pattern; nucleoli not evident
Rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Adjacent later-stage normoblast with small pyknotic nucleus and pinkish-gray cytoplasm
Background of maturing granulocytes (metamyelocytes, band forms) and a platelet clump in a marrow aspirate
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a small cluster of erythroid precursors among maturing granulocytic cells. Two cells in the cluster have round nuclei with coarsely granular chromatin, no conspicuous nucleoli and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm, and an adjacent cell shows a condensed nucleus with more hemoglobinized cytoplasm, illustrating erythroid maturation. Granulocytic precursors, including metamyelocytes and bands, are present nearby. Findings are consistent with basophilic normoblasts in a normally maturing marrow.

ddx.vs: Proerythroblasts are larger with finer chromatin, prominent nucleoli and often cytoplasmic blebs, whereas these cells have coarser chromatin without visible nucleoli.
Plasma cells have an eccentric nucleus with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof, unlike the central round nuclei here.
Lymphocytes have denser, smudgy chromatin and paler sky-blue cytoplasm, not the intensely basophilic cytoplasm seen here.
Polychromatophilic normoblasts are smaller with more condensed chromatin and gray-lilac cytoplasm as hemoglobin accumulates.
